response.original_title: Kevin James Doyle V. The City of New York
response.overview: Navigating the unforgiving streets of New York City is hard enough before you add in the careless landlords, stolen property, scam artists and the ever present empty bank account. Comedian and storyteller Kevin James Doyle weaves together a funny tale of his unique experience living in New York that is not far off from what every New Yorker has gone through.
